name: rentctl
description: Leased dev environments for AI coding sessions — every server dies when its session ends, so none are left running rogue.

interface.shortDescription: Leased dev servers that die when the session ends
interface.longDescription: rentctl starts your project's dev server on a leased port and stops it when the Codex session ends, so no server is left running rogue. The plugin adds the env_up / env_down / env_ls / env_sweep tools and the session hooks; it runs the rentctl CLI installed on this machine (uv tool install rentctl).
defaultPrompt: Why won't my dev server start?
Stop the dev server for this project
